COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.

2. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Data Transmission Media, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Transmission Media.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Transmission Media.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Transmission Media.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Transmission Media.

5. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

7. When learning Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage 1.5 Central Processing Unit 1.6 Operating System 1.7 Computer s.

8. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.

9. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

12. When learning Central Processing Unit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Central Processing Unit.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Central Processing Unit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Central Processing Unit.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Operating System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer set up and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
